attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR), Physical Therapy Licensing and Disciplinary Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of approved sponsors only (APTA and components incl. IPTA, FSBPT, CAPTE-accredited PT/PTA programs, Division-licensed sponsors); 1 CE hour = 50 minutes. Also: teaching (max 50%), ABPTS specialist certification (40 h), APTA residency/fellowship (1 h per 2 h, max 20), publications/posters (max 50%), self-study with test (max 75%), APTA publication quizzes (max 50%), live virtual courses, IPTA district meetings (max 5), in-services (max 5), CPR/BLS/ACLS/PALS (max 5), clinical instructor (PT max 10, PTA max 5), journal clubs (max 5), association board service (max 8); academic courses 15 h per semester hour.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal after original issuance of the license.
rules.carryover: Not provided for in the rule.
rules.audit_note: Certify full CE compliance on the renewal application; the Division may require evidence; keep proof at least 5 years.

topics.who: Ethical practice of physical therapy, including jurisprudence (within the 40 hours)
All individual license holders, every renewal from the first renewal after initial licensure
Every renewal that requires CE; counts toward CE hours. From July 1, 2026 licensees who report providing maternal health care need implicit bias training covering maternal health risk factors
Alzheimer's disease and other dementias; before the first renewal requiring CE (renewals on or after Jan 1, 2025), then every 6 years (20 ILCS 2105/2105-365); counts toward CE
Before the first renewal requiring CE (renewals on or after Jan 1, 2025), then every 6 years (20 ILCS 2105/2105-370); counts toward CE

DCFS child abuse mandated reporter training: PTs/PTAs who work with children complete it at least every 6 years; all must attest at each renewal that they understand mandated-reporter duties; may count toward CE

rules.notes: Prerenewal period = 24 months before September 30 of the renewal year. PT licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years. CE from unapproved sponsors in Illinois is not credited; out-of-state CE from nonapproved sponsors needs approval ($20). The IDFPR-mandated 1-hour courses (sexual harassment, implicit bias, dementia, cultural competency) are listed on IDFPR's CE page; implicit bias, dementia and cultural competency count toward CE hours.
